<document id="card-metal">
TheˆPremiumˆmetalˆcardˆPremiumˆmembersˆgetˆaˆmetalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆworksˆexactlyˆlikeˆtheˆplasticˆcard,ˆwithˆtheˆsameˆnumber,ˆlimitsˆandˆcontrols.ˆ##ˆGettingˆyourˆmetalˆcardˆWhenˆyouˆupgradeˆtoˆPremium,ˆtheˆappˆasksˆwhetherˆyouˆwantˆaˆmetalˆcardˆnowˆorˆatˆyourˆnextˆrenewal.ˆIfˆyouˆorderˆitˆnow,ˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆmetalˆone.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆitˆReplacementsˆforˆaˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamagedˆmetalˆcardˆareˆmetalˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆisˆfreeˆonˆPremiumˆtoo,ˆandˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆleaveˆPremiumˆYourˆmetalˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆitˆexpires.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆorˆifˆyouˆneedˆaˆreplacement,ˆyou'llˆgetˆaˆplasticˆcard.ˆ##ˆDisposalˆMetalˆcardsˆcan'tˆbeˆcutˆwithˆscissors.ˆWhenˆyouˆreplaceˆone,ˆyouˆcanˆmailˆitˆbackˆtoˆusˆinˆtheˆprepaidˆenvelopeˆthatˆcomesˆwithˆtheˆnewˆcard,ˆandˆwe'llˆrecycleˆit.ˆContactlessˆworksˆonˆmetalˆcardsˆtheˆsameˆwayˆitˆdoesˆonˆplastic.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-replacement-premium">
CardˆreplacementˆfeesˆonˆPremiumˆThisˆisˆwhatˆaˆreplacementˆcardˆcostsˆonˆtheˆPremiumˆplan,ˆwhetherˆit'sˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged.ˆ|ˆ|ˆCostˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆReplacementˆcardˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆStandardˆshippingˆ(7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆ(2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆOnˆPremiumˆbothˆtheˆcardˆandˆexpeditedˆshippingˆareˆfree.ˆYourˆreplacementˆisˆaˆmetalˆcard.ˆ##ˆWhenˆweˆdon'tˆchargeˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆwhenˆaˆcardˆisˆlostˆinˆtheˆmail,ˆwhenˆweˆreplaceˆaˆcardˆbecauseˆofˆaˆproblemˆonˆourˆside,ˆorˆforˆyourˆautomaticˆrenewalˆcard.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆorderˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆReplaceˆcard.ˆPickˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆshippingˆspeed.ˆFeesˆareˆchargedˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆyouˆplaceˆtheˆorder.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆforˆyouˆinˆtheˆappˆchat.ˆTheˆsameˆfeesˆapplyˆeitherˆway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-replacement-plus">
CardˆreplacementˆfeesˆonˆPlusˆThisˆisˆwhatˆaˆreplacementˆcardˆcostsˆonˆtheˆPlusˆplan,ˆwhetherˆit'sˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged.ˆ|ˆ|ˆCostˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆReplacementˆcardˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆStandardˆshippingˆ(7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆ(2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆOnˆPlusˆtheˆcardˆitselfˆisˆfree.ˆYouˆonlyˆpayˆifˆyouˆchooseˆexpeditedˆshipping.ˆ##ˆWhenˆweˆdon'tˆchargeˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆwhenˆaˆcardˆisˆlostˆinˆtheˆmail,ˆwhenˆweˆreplaceˆaˆcardˆbecauseˆofˆaˆproblemˆonˆourˆside,ˆorˆforˆyourˆautomaticˆrenewalˆcard.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆorderˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆReplaceˆcard.ˆPickˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆshippingˆspeed.ˆFeesˆareˆchargedˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆyouˆplaceˆtheˆorder.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆforˆyouˆinˆtheˆappˆchat.ˆTheˆsameˆfeesˆapplyˆeitherˆway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
